Grab a mic. Grab your bestie. Drag King Karaoke is coming for Azúcar and it's about to be UNHINGED in the best way. 🎤🔥 Beah Hazard hosts the night, the kings take over the Lounge, and the sign-up sheet fills up fast — so get there early if you wanna sing. Free entry means zero excuses. This is the night queens throw for everyone, and everyone means YOU. Come scream your favorite song into the mic surrounded by people who are just as extra as you are. 👑🎶

📅 Wednesday, September 16 | 7PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 Free Entry

The mic drops warm in your hand, the lights go low, and somewhere in the crowd Beah Hazard is hyping up the next singer like it's the finale of a show only you get to be in. 🎤✨ Voices crack, wigs are perfect, confidence is at 200% whether you can actually sing or not. The kings bring the swagger, the room brings the energy, and by the third song everybody's belting the chorus together like it's their personal anthem. This is karaoke but with glitter in the air and heart behind every note. 💫🖤

An event put on by queens, for everyone — that's not just a tagline, that's the whole vibe at Azúcar this Wednesday. 🖤👑 Come as you are, sing what you want, cheer for whoever's brave enough to grab the mic next. Beah Hazard's hosting, the drag kings are ready to perform just for you, and the Lounge is turning into your new favorite hangout. No pressure, no judgment, just community, laughs, and maybe the best karaoke rendition you've ever witnessed. Bring your people. Or come make new ones. 🎤💜

Save the date — Drag King Karaoke takes over Azúcar's Lounge this Wednesday, September 16th at 7PM. 🎤 Hosted by Beah Hazard, with the drag kings performing and singing just for you, this one's free entry and open to everyone who wants a mic and a moment. It happens every other Wednesday, so if you miss this one, mark the next. Come early, sign up to sing, and stick around for a full night of performances and karaoke chaos. Simple as that. 👑🖤
